```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "The output polarity was inverted: vinp drove the output-side device, so the follower loop latched to VDD and M1 went into triode. Swapping the inputs fixes this. The tail is now sized at the reference diode's Vds so the 1:N mirror ratio holds, which fixes the 103 uA overshoot and the power violation. The PMOS load gets a higher gm/Id for headroom."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 11.0, 19.0),   # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.6, 0.3, 1.2),      # diff pair L
    "gmid3": (11.0, 8.0, 14.0),    # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),      # PMOS load L
    "gmid5": (12.0, 9.0, 15.0),    # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "L5":    (1.2, 0.5, 2.0),      # tail / bias mirror L
    "Itail": (70e-6, 55e-6, 78e-6) # tail current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    It = p["Itail"]
    Id1 = It / 2.0

    # Bias reference diode, then tail sized at the SAME vds so the mirror ratio is exactly It/iref
    m6 = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], It, vds=m6.vgs)
    # PMOS mirror load (diode side has vsd equal to |vgs|)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Id1, vds=0.7)
    m1g = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1g.vgs, 0.15)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=max(vdd - m3.vgs - vtail, 0.2), vsb=vtail)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M6", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # Non-inverting side drives the diode branch; inverting side drives the output branch
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    A0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cx = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cx)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    slew = It / cout
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.3 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    sn = 2 * (8 * kT / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = 3.0 * math.sqrt(sn)
    ro5 = 1.0 / m5.gds
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * ro5 * (m3.gm / (m3.gm + m3.gds)))
    psrr = db(A0)
    swing = (vdd - m3.vdsat - 0.1) - (vtail + m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    power = vdd * (It + iref)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "settle": settle,
        "noise_1k": noise, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr, "swing": swing,
        "power": power,
    }
```
